verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas docs explicitly confirm it issues founder equity with customizable vesting, files 83(b) elections for all C-corp founders, and provides legal documents developed with Cooley, plus a dashboard to view incorporation documents — directly matching the story's core elements. Community evidence corroborates a smooth incorporation experience, though notes some legwork/gaps remain outside Atlas's scope (e.g., no IP assignment specifics mentioned, and one user needed Clerky for extra needs). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of IP assignment agreements as a named deliverable, and independent verification of 83(b) filing accuracy/timeliness.
